verdict.summary: Round 6 finds no correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defect. The registry checker remains fail-closed for missing or malformed registry data, unresolved registered paths and recipes, incomplete per-anchor scope annotations, and undeclared swept golden files. The focused mutation self-test and all 14 unit tests pass, including direct non-vacuous tests of C1/C2/C3 and live-registry coverage for all three declared companions. The fast-fix workflow and its byte-pinned golden remain synchronized. With no findings in rounds 5 or 6, progress is stagnant.
